fullText.simplified:
第三章、石猴当大王

    石猴跳进了瀑布，发现了石桥，桥后面还有大山洞。洞口写着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”几个大字。
    石猴想，瀑布像帘子一样，山洞在它的后面，所以“水帘洞”应该就是指这里了。外面很热，这里却很凉快，而且非常安全。好地方，真的是好地方。
    石猴兴奋极了，马上跳出瀑布，叫大家进去看看。猴子们一个又一个地跳了进来，他们高兴地叫道：“我们有新家了！我们有新家了！”
    大家欢笑着，好像过年一样。有的猴子拿了石碗做帽子，有的猴子躺在床上不起来，有的猴子在石椅上跳上跳下。
    这时候，石猴跳上了桌子，举起手，大叫了一声：“安静！”
    猴子们马上安静了下来，他们抬头看着石猴。
    “刚才谁说跳进来的人当大王？”石猴看着大家，认真地问道。
    猴子们你看看我，我看看你。突然，老猴子第一个跪下，向石猴叫道：“大王！”接着所有猴子都跪下了，大声道：“大王！大王！”
    石猴很高兴，把尾巴抬得高高的，然后从左到右看了一遍眼前的猴子们，说道：“要叫‘美猴王’，以后这就是我们的新家！”
    “美猴王万岁！美猴王万岁！”大家举着石碗，高兴地叫道。
    从那以后，美猴王就带着猴子们住在了水帘洞里。夏天很热，美猴王带大家去清凉的河里游泳。冬天很冷，美猴王带大家在洞里生火做饭。美猴王总能找到最甜的果子和最清的泉水。就这样，他带着大家快乐幸福地过了约三百年。
fullText.traditional:
第三章、石猴當大王

    石猴跳進了瀑布，發現了石橋，橋後面還有大山洞。洞口寫著“花果山福地，水簾洞洞天”幾個大字。
    石猴想，瀑布像簾子一樣，山洞在它的後面，所以“水簾洞”應該就是指這裡了。外面很熱，這裡卻很涼快，而且非常安全。好地方，真的是好地方。
    石猴興奮極了，馬上跳出瀑布，叫大家進去看看。猴子們一個又一個地跳了進來，他們高興地叫道：“我們有新家了！我們有新家了！”
    大家歡笑著，好像過年一樣。有的猴子拿了石碗做帽子，有的猴子躺在床上不起來，有的猴子在石椅上跳上跳下。
    這時候，石猴跳上了桌子，舉起手，大叫了一聲：“安靜！”
    猴子們馬上安靜了下來，他們抬頭看著石猴。
    “剛才誰說跳進來的人當大王？”石猴看著大家，認真地問道。
    猴子們你看看我，我看看你。突然，老猴子第一個跪下，向石猴叫道：“大王！”接著所有猴子都跪下了，大聲道：“大王！大王！”
    石猴很高興，把尾巴抬得高高的，然後從左到右看了一遍眼前的猴子們，說道：“要叫‘美猴王’，以後這就是我們的新家！”
    “美猴王萬歲！美猴王萬歲！”大家舉著石碗，高興地叫道。
    從那以後，美猴王就帶著猴子們住在了水簾洞裡。夏天很熱，美猴王帶大家去清涼的河裡游泳。冬天很冷，美猴王帶大家在洞裡生火做飯。美猴王總能找到最甜的果子和最清的泉水。就這樣，他帶著大家快樂幸福地過了約三百年。

sentences.english: Then, all the monkeys knelt down and said loudly, “Great King! Great King!”

sentences.english: The stone monkey was very happy.  He raised his tail high, then looked at the monkeys in front of him from left to right.

sentences.traditional: 說道：“要叫‘美猴王’，以後這就是我們的新家！”

sentences.english: He said, “You shall call me the ‘Handsome Monkey King’. From now on, this will be our new home!”

sentences.english: From then on, the Handsome Monkey King led the other monkeys, and together they lived in the Water Curtain Cave.

sentences.traditional: 冬天很冷，美猴王帶大家在洞裡生火做飯。

sentences.english: In the winter, it was very cold, so the Handsome Monkey King took everyone to make a fire and cook inside the cave.

sentences.simplified: 美猴王总能找到最甜的果子和最清的泉水。
sentences.traditional: 美猴王總能找到最甜的果子和最清的泉水。

sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King could always find the sweetest fruits and the clearest spring water.

sentences.traditional: 就這樣，他帶著大家快樂幸福地過了約三百年。

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: The Stone Monkey Becomes King
The stone monkey jumped into the waterfall and discovered a stone bridge. Behind the bridge, there was a large cave.
At the entrance of the cave, several large characters were written: “Blessed Land of Mount Huaguo, Water Curtain Cave”.
The stone monkey thought, the waterfall is like a curtain, and the cave is behind it.
So, “Water Curtain Cave” must be referring to this place.
Outside, it was very hot, but here it was cool and also very safe. What a good place, it really was a good place.
The stone monkey was extremely excited. He immediately jumped out of the waterfall and called everyone to come in and take a look.
The monkeys jumped in one after another, happily shouting, “We have a new home! We have a new home!”
Everyone laughed with joy, as if celebrating the Chinese New Year.
Some monkeys took the stone bowls and put them on as hats, ..
.. some monkeys lay in the bed and wouldn’t get up, and yet other monkeys jumped up and down on the stone chairs.
At this moment, the stone monkey jumped onto the table, raised his hand, and shouted, “Quiet!”
The monkeys immediately quieted down. They raised their heads and looked up at the stone monkey.
“Who said just now that whoever jumps in will become king?” the stone monkey asked seriously, looking at everyone.
The monkeys all looked at each other.
Suddenly, the old monkey was the first to kneel down and call out to the stone monkey, “Great King!”
Then, all the monkeys knelt down and said loudly, “Great King! Great King!”
The stone monkey was very happy.  He raised his tail high, then looked at the monkeys in front of him from left to right.
He said, “You shall call me the ‘Handsome Monkey King’. From now on, this will be our new home!”
“Long live the Handsome Monkey King! Long live the Handsome Monkey King!” Everyone raised their stone bowls and shouted happily.
From then on, the Handsome Monkey King led the other monkeys, and together they lived in the Water Curtain Cave.
In the summer, it was very hot, so the Handsome Monkey King took everyone to swim in the cool river.
In the winter, it was very cold, so the Handsome Monkey King took everyone to make a fire and cook inside the cave.
The Handsome Monkey King could always find the sweetest fruits and the clearest spring water.
And so, he led the monkeys in a life of happiness and joy for about three hundred years.
